purpose: Continue the already frozen baseline sequence from successful completion events without periodic polling or quality-dependent branching.
sequence: collect and qualify dense control pair 2 after its successful final summary
lock and hash the time-to-quality target from all three dense controls
commit the third control result, target lock, program pins, and transition record
after a one-time 15-minute cooldown, verify the live gate and launch candidate pair 0
for each successful candidate summary, disable the event trigger before collection, collect and commit the result, then schedule the next fixed candidate after the same cooldown
after candidate pair 2, run and commit the fixed six-cell proxy analysis

event_contract.training_exit_wait: wait on the training process pidfd, not a status-polling loop
event_contract.one_shot: the path unit is stopped before collection so a persistent PathExists condition cannot retrigger a failure
event_contract.cooldown: one systemd monotonic timer per next run, 15 minutes, followed by one live check
event_contract.on_failure: stop the sequence, retain logs and artifacts, and launch no successor
event_contract.repository: require a clean worktree before each transition and launch; commit every qualified transition before scheduling its successor

launch_gate.gpu: exact named RTX 3090 and UUID, zero compute processes, zero utilization, temperature at most 50 C
launch_gate.storage: pinned ext4 UUID and absent run-specific checkpoint/result targets
launch_gate.evidence: three control results and target lock precede candidate 0; each prior candidate result precedes its fixed successor
